result.summary: The page renders largely correctly. Found 1 minor styling inconsistency related to the favorite (heart) icons.

issues.description: The favorite heart icons on the two restaurant cards ('Tokumaru Ramen Bar' and the pizza card) have inconsistent styling — one appears as a plain white outline while the other sits inside a dark filled circular background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon appearance across all cards so both use the same background treatment and contrast for a consistent look.
